member.name: P:Syncfusion.Web.UI.WebControls.Grid.GridWebControl.ImageUrlPath
member.summary: Indicates the root path that will be used to store images that are automatically generated by the grid when the OutputFormat is set to DiskFile mode. This directory has to exist and the ASP.NET user account needs to be provided access to it for the grid to be able to generate images. The default setting is that the grid stores images in the base virtual directory. For this reason if the OutputFormat is set to DiskFile, user ASP.NET should be given write permission for your application root directory. The format of this path must be relative to the application root(default is .\\).
